facts.fact: Giga says the government has committed to connecting every village with more than 500 residents and has financed 100% of infrastructure deployment through its national broadband provider BoFiNet.

BWA.note: Only a general remark on high digital literacy; no programme or measured share is stated.

facts.fact: Giga says Starlink launched services in Botswana in early 2024, offering satellite internet at about USD 48 a month for 150 Mbps.
